description: A clean, minimal site header with a bordered top-and-bottom rule, a wordmark logo on the left, an optional slot for a small announcement banner beside it, and a row of plain text links on the right. Below the medium breakpoint the links collapse behind a hamburger icon into a simple stacked list, each link staggering in with a short fade/slide-in animation as the menu opens. No background color of its own, so it reads as sitting directly on the page.
example_prompts: A minimal navbar with a border on top and bottom and simple text links
Simple site header with a logo, a few nav links, and a mobile hamburger menu
Clean navigation bar with an optional announcement banner next to the logo

description: A three-column SaaS navbar: a small logo mark and wordmark pinned to the far left, the main nav links centered in the middle of the bar independent of the logo/actions width, and a 'Sign In' link plus a solid primary 'Start Free Trial' button on the right, separated by a thin vertical divider. On mobile, the links and actions collapse into a right-side sliding drawer (dimmed backdrop, slide-in panel) triggered by a menu icon.
example_prompts: SaaS navbar with the logo on the left, nav links centered, and sign in / CTA buttons on the right
Navigation bar with a centered menu and a mobile slide-out drawer
Header with logo, centered nav links, a sign-in link, and a primary CTA button
